program.section_heading: Photography - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS592/AS592C/CE592
outcomes: Demonstrate competency using all facets of a camera to best suit the photographic need that is required in the scene by adjusting aperture, shutter speed, and ISO with strict regard to a creative use of depth of field depending on the style of photography
Identify, describe, and demonstrate formal concepts and contemporary forms of photographic composition.
Understand how to manage ambient light as well as control and modify added light into the photographic frame
Choose a field of professional photography and learn the professional and artistic requirements needed to enter the chosen industry
Obtain a professional level competency of digitally editing photographs using Adobe software
Creatively approach the concept and idea of photographic style, choose and develop a style that best fits the student’s chosen industry

notes: The page prints one combined requirements list for the A.S. Degree and Certificate of Achievement (AS592/AS592C/CE592); the degree shares these requirements and the program learning outcomes list, which is printed once for the program as a whole.
The heading is printed three times with slightly different codes; the third adds 'As592B'.

Under 'Required Courses' (Units: 12.00), 'Select one of the following: 3.00' is read as applying only to PHO-8 and PHO-20, with PHO-9, PHO-14 and PHO-19 required; this matches the 12-unit heading total (3 + 9). The stated 12 recorded on the 'Required Courses' block covers the whole heading including the select-one block.
PHO-11 Commercial and Advertising Photography appears in the electives but is not in the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
Several courses are marked '( Historical )' in the catalog (PHO-20, PHO-14, PHO-19, PHO-7, PHO-11); a reviewer may want to confirm they are still offered for 2026-2027.
The degree refers to general education requirements without naming a specific GE pattern.
